full_judgment: 3. Defendant-opposite party No. 5 and the present defendant-petitioner contested the suit by filing written statement. It is the case of the present petitioner that the land comprising an area of 12.18 acres in plot No. 148 khatian 31/35, 93/31 (ka) Mouza Chalia JL No. 626 in Upazila Savar belonged to Dhaka Nawab Estabe and the land was given in settlement by the then Manager of the said Estate on 15-8-51 in favour of Abdus Samad, Abdur Rahman, Abdur Rashid who paid rent to the Nowab Estate Dhaka and they were recognized tenants and while Abdur Rahman and Abdur Rashid were possessing the land they sold 5.72 acres of land in plot No. 148 to Shahidur Rahman who mutated his name in the SA khatian in Misc. Case No. 5(b) of 73-74 for 5.72 acres. The name of Shahidur Rahman was also recorded in the RS Khatian. Thereafter Saidur Rahman sold 4.09 acres to the present petitioner by different registered kabalas and handed over the transferred land to the petitioner who thereafter mutated their names in the relevant SA Record of Right in Misc. Case No. 674(B)P-1/75-76 and paid rent and they developed the entire land and allotted the same to the members of the society. It is also the case of the present petitioner that during RS operation the plaintiff opposite parties filed Misc. Case No. 34.75 before the ADC (Rev.) Dhaka praying for mutation of their name in place of Sahidur Rahman which was ultimately rejected. The plaintiff opposite parties have no right title, and possession in the suit property and their kabalas were created with ulterior motive.
